name: Pearl of Power

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Regain a spell slot
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): regain one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower.

summary: Once a day, regain one spent spell slot of level 3 or lower.
text: Carry this pearl and a Magic action lets you get back one expended spell slot no higher than level 3. After that it stays inert until the next dawn.
